observation: The input lowering gate excludes the exact backend-resource condition this candidate-producing transformation reduces. It is not an IR semantic failure and does not justify relaxing the backend storage cap.
proposed_change: Admit semantically accepted source schedules only when the complete blocker set is METAL_PRIVATE_STORAGE_LIMIT. Preserve structural guards and re-assess every complete result, including its storage limit. Keep original input immutable.
